name: Longstrider
description: You touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends. You can affect one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1st.
effect: A long, tireless stride for 8 hours: you travel 25% faster, and move 2 more squares a turn in any fight.
notes: Out of combat: travel 25% faster for 8 hours, enough for most roads; +2 squares of movement in any fight in that time.
